parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request may be different.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the NAT gateway.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: SnatEntryId
parameters.description: The ID of the SNAT entry to delete.

parameters.name: SnatTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the SNAT table to which the SNAT entry belongs.
